defmodule CryptoVault.HMAC do
  @moduledoc """
  HMAC-based key derivation and verification for CryptoVault.
  Deployed as part of the secrets-manager sidecar in K8s.
  """

  @max_key_length 64
  @block_size 64
  @ipad_byte 0x36
  @opad_byte 0x5C

  @doc """
  Derives a fixed-length authentication tag from a message and secret key.
  Uses iterative expansion when derived_length exceeds single hash output.
  """
  def derive_tag(key, message, derived_length) when is_binary(key) and is_binary(message) do
    normalized_key = normalize_key(key)
    iterations = compute_iterations(derived_length)
    
    expand_key(normalized_key, message, iterations, derived_length)
  end

  defp normalize_key(key) when byte_size(key) > @max_key_length do
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, key)
  end

  defp normalize_key(key) do
    pad_length = @block_size - byte_size(key)
    key <> :binary.copy(<<0>>, pad_length)
  end

  @doc """
  Computes number of HMAC iterations needed for the requested derived length.
  Each iteration produces 32 bytes (SHA-256 output).
  """
  def compute_iterations(derived_length) when is_integer(derived_length) and derived_length > 0 do
    # Integer division ceiling: (derived_length + 31) / 32
    div(derived_length + 31, 32)
  end

  defp expand_key(key, message, iterations, derived_length) do
    result =
      1..iterations
      |> Enum.map(fn i ->
        counter = <<i::unsigned-big-integer-size(32)>>
        hmac_round(key, message <> counter)
      end)
      |> IO.iodata_to_binary()

    # Truncate to exact requested length
    <<tag::binary-size(derived_length), _rest::binary>> = result
    {:ok, tag}
  end

  defp hmac_round(key, data) do
    ipad_key = xor_pad(key, @ipad_byte)
    opad_key = xor_pad(key, @opad_byte)

    inner = :crypto.hash(:sha256, ipad_key <> data)
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, opad_key <> inner)
  end

  defp xor_pad(key, pad_byte) do
    for <<byte <- key>>, into: <<>>, do: <<Bitwise.bxor(byte, pad_byte)>>
  end
end

defmodule CryptoVault.TokenVerifier do
  @moduledoc """
  Verifies service-mesh authentication tokens.
  Tokens carry a length-prefixed HMAC tag for integrity.
  """

  @secret_env "VAULT_HMAC_SECRET"

  def verify_token(token_binary) when is_binary(token_binary) do
    with {:ok, secret} <- fetch_secret(),
         {:ok, {payload, claimed_tag}} <- parse_token(token_binary),
         {:ok, expected_tag} <- compute_expected_tag(secret, payload, claimed_tag) do
      constant_time_compare(expected_tag, claimed_tag)
    end
  end

  defp fetch_secret do
    case System.get_env(@secret_env) do
      nil -> {:error, :missing_secret}
      secret when byte_size(secret) >= 32 -> {:ok, secret}
      _ -> {:error, :weak_secret}
    end
  end

  defp parse_token(<<tag_len::unsigned-big-integer-size(16), rest::binary>>) do
    # tag_len is a 16-bit unsigned integer from the wire
    # Compute total allocation size for the derived tag
    alloc_size = tag_len * 8  # Convert from 8-byte blocks to bytes
    
    if byte_size(rest) >= alloc_size do
      <<tag::binary-size(alloc_size), payload::binary>> = rest
      {:ok, {payload, tag}}
    else
      {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp parse_token(_), do: {:error, :malformed_token}

  defp compute_expected_tag(secret, payload, claimed_tag) do
    derived_length = byte_size(claimed_tag)
    CryptoVault.HMAC.derive_tag(secret, payload, derived_length)
  end

  defp constant_time_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
    result =
      :binary.bin_to_list(a)
      |> Enum.zip(:binary.bin_to_list(b))
      |> Enum.reduce(0, fn {x, y}, acc -> Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(x, y)) end)

    if result == 0, do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_tag}
  end

  defp constant_time_compare(_, _), do: {:error, :length_mismatch}
end

defmodule CryptoVault.K8sHealthCheck do
  @moduledoc """
  Kubernetes liveness/readiness probe handler.
  """

  def check do
    case System.get_env("VAULT_HMAC_SECRET") do
      nil -> {:error, 503}
      _ -> {:ok, 200}
    end
  end
end
